# Integration

companion.project.json and source/design/project.json preserve the Companion v6 design envelope. source/shell.project.json carries the separate preset and runtime contract. source/src/core owns host-free behavior; src/presentation owns the selected renderer; src/targets owns runtime integration. The compiled seed preserves surface/component IDs. Source-owned business behavior does not automatically round-trip into design JSON.

Regeneration protects edited/unowned files. Changing preset or frontend is not a migration: choose a new output directory and reconcile deliberately. Hybrid runtimes share source but not memory, authentication, storage or synchronization across processes. No service or backend is implied.
